title: CrowdStrike Named a Leader in the Inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Integrated Security Operations Center Systems (ISOC) and a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM
summary: CrowdStrike is named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for ISOC and the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM.
body_markdown:
*Positioned furthest right for Completeness of Vision and highest for Ability to Execute among all vendors evaluated in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for ISOC, we believe CrowdStrike drives the shift to the agentic SOC*


**AUSTIN, Texas – November 25, 2026 –**[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/) (NASDAQ: CRWD) today announced it has been named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Integrated Security Operations Center Systems (ISOC)1, positioned furthest right for Completeness of Vision and highest for Ability to Execute among all vendors evaluated. CrowdStrike was also named a Leader in the[2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/resources/reports/gartner-mq-siem/) 2.


As adversaries weaponize AI agents to attack across every domain at machine speed and enterprise agents act faster than any human can respond, we believe these recognitions reflect how CrowdStrike delivers the security model organizations need: the agentic SOC. Intelligent agents work together across unified data and shared context to stop attacks from outside and unauthorized agent behavior from within, at the speed of the threat.


“Human-speed response cannot stop machine-speed threats, and an agent is only as good as the data it operates on,” said AJ Shipley, chief product officer at CrowdStrike. “The Falcon platform holds the industry’s richest security data and deepest adversary intelligence, and Next-Gen SIEM brings every other source onto it. That unified architecture lets AI agents fight AI threats inside and out, with speed, precision, and control. We believe these recognitions reflect that Next-Gen SIEM and the Falcon platform define the agentic SOC.”


**The Integrated SOC Runs on One Platform**
In our opinion, the inaugural ISOC Magic Quadrant recognizes a new market: SIEM, EDR, threat intelligence, and AI SOC agents, delivered as one integrated system, not a bundle of point products. In the Magic Quadrant for Integrated Security Operations Center Systems, CrowdStrike was positioned furthest right for Completeness of Vision and highest for Ability to Execute. We believe this reflects the strength of a single-sensor, single-platform architecture generating nearly seven trillion events daily across endpoint, identity, SaaS, cloud, and network.


[CrowdStrike® Charlotte AI™](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/charlotte-ai/) and[CrowdStrike® Charlotte AI™ AgentWorks](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/charlotte-ai/charlotte-ai-agentworks/) agents run on that unified data foundation. CrowdStrike's elite analysts reinforce these agents with expert decisions from every MDR and IR engagement, making them smarter with every breach stopped.[Agent Insider Threat Detection](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/press-releases/crowdstrike-extends-agentic-soc-detect-stop-agent-insider-threat/) and[coordinated, multi-agent investigations](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/press-releases/crowdstrike-unveils-next-evolution-of-the-agentic-soc/) across every domain at the same time stop the agent weaponized against you and the one that turns from within, at machine speed.[CrowdStrike® Charlotte Agentic SOAR](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/charlotte-ai/agentic-soar/) carries every investigation through to response, enabling teams to set the autonomy level for each, from human approval to fully autonomous execution.


**Falcon Next-Gen SIEM: The Engine Powering the Agentic SOC**
The agentic SOC needs every signal, wherever it lives.[CrowdStrike Falcon® Next-Gen SIEM](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/next-gen-siem/) brings any third-party source into Falcon alongside first-party data, giving agents one complete picture to reason over. Legacy SIEMs force a tradeoff between cost and visibility, creating blind spots where the adversary operates.


Certified data pipelines, built on[Crowdstrike® Falcon Onum™](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/next-gen-siem/falcon-onum/) streaming technology, close that gap. They filter data at ingestion so agents process only what matters, and run detection in-stream so threats are caught before data ever lands. Certified by[CrowdStrike Falcon Complete](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/services/falcon-complete-mdr/) , no security-relevant data is dropped, while reducing storage costs by up to 50 percent.

**About CrowdStrike**
[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/) (NASDAQ: CRWD), a global cybersecurity leader, has redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced cloud-native platform for protecting critical areas of enterprise risk: endpoints and cloud workloads, identity and data.


Powered by the CrowdStrike Security Cloud and world-class AI, the CrowdStrike Falcon® platform leverages real-time indicators of attack, threat intelligence, evolving adversary tradecraft, and enriched telemetry from across the enterprise to deliver hyper-accurate detections, automated protection and remediation, elite threat hunting, and prioritized observability of vulnerabilities.


Purpose-built in the cloud with a single lightweight-agent architecture, the Falcon platform delivers rapid and scalable deployment, superior protection and performance, reduced complexity, and immediate time-to-value.
